Jonathan told him he could not say for sure, that he might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but that he did not do anything illegal himself. Christian said he would look into it discreetly. Jonathan thanked him and said he trusted Christian to handle it carefully.
- Through his own investigation, Christian came to believe/learn that Jonathan is being framed. He felt determined and protective and decided to clear Jonathan’s name. He told Jonathan he believed someone was setting him up, said he had leads, and planned to gather more evidence. Jonathan thanked him.
- Christian then came to believe the real culprit is someone close to both him and Jonathan. He felt betrayed and resolute. He told Jonathan he had found out who was behind it—someone they both know and trust—and planned to confront that person and bring them to justice. Jonathan warned him the person is dangerous and said he trusted Christian to do what is right.
